content:
A clip shared by a leaker with a previous track record of accurate leaks appears to show two new iPhone 18 Pro colors on a retail display.

The brief clip shows what we expect to be a deep cherry color and a blue, but it is almost certainly fake…

The 14-second video shows a person holding a deep cherry iPhone 18 Pro Max with a deep blue iPhone 17 Pro Max next to it for comparison; a light blue model is also on the stand.

The environment looks like a retail store. Macworld thinks there is a chance the video is real.

I am more skeptical.

My colleague Fernando Silva attended the recent IFA trade show and reported that every case company has dummy units that look and feel very realistic, so making these would not be difficult. Moreover, the store environment looks suspicious — the display table is too small for a store, the product labels look like they are just placed there without being fixed, and there is almost nothing that looks like a proper store layout in the background.

Finally, although the leaker does have a track record of accurate leaks, recently he has just been reposting things from Chinese social media.
